adjudication.rationale: The diff makes `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` an array and, for COLLECTIVE team events, `handleNewBooking` explicitly appends other hosts’ destination calendars (`evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`). However, when persisting the booking it only connects `evt.destinationCalendar[0]` to `booking.destinationCalendar` (`connect: { id: evt.destinationCalendar[0].id }`), meaning only a single DestinationCalendar is stored on the Booking. Later, `confirm.handler` rebuilds `evt.destinationCalendar` solely from `booking.destinationCalendar` (wrapping the single relation in an array), so the additional hosts’ destination calendars cannot be reconstructed at confirmation time. Since `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` now iterates over `event.destinationCalendar` to create events, confirmation will only create calendar events for the first stored destination calendar in this case.
